_comment: Read by third_party/recomp/tools (install-game.py, make-dist.py; see gameproject.py). Modelled on vita-recomps/ss-delta. The port targets the last update, 01.22 (installed with the 1.00 dump). libult ships in sce_module/ but LBP did not load it in a 60 s --dump-elfs run (nor in the baseline log), so it is not listed (UNVERIFIED.md). The firmware modules LBP runs as guest code (sysmodule, libSceFt2, libpvf, libscemp4) are recompiled too, as fw_<name> like ss-delta's, so the game runs with the JIT off (M2). All modules are recompiled at their load addresses (the --dump-elfs dumps).
